name: English
description: Casualty Psychology Gritty & Grounded English Dialogue

psychology_frustration: Give me a break. Just one.
Why does nothing ever go right?
Are you kidding me right now?
I don't have time for this!
Why is it always like this?
psychology_anger: Don't look at me like that.
I'm going to tear this whole place apart.
I will rip your throat out.
I'm about to lose my mind.
Get the hell out of my face.
Look at me again, I dare you.
I hate everything about this place.
psychology_fear: I don't want to die down here.
psychology_panic: I'm dying... I'm dying right now...
psychology_melancholy: I wish it would just end.
psychology_contentment: One foot in front of the other.
psychology_near_corpse_single: Oh god... is that a body?
psychology_corpse_desensitized: There really are a lot of us down here.
I think I'm getting used to the sight.
I've seen a lot of these by now.
This place is FILLED with corpses!
I wonder if I'll find someone living down here...
Not a good mortality rate in here.
Someone ought to arrange a funeral for 'em...
At least they're out of it.
psychology_near_animal_corpse: Whatever killed this might still be around.
At least it wasn't a person.
Poor creature didn't stand a chance.
psychology_corpse_and_trap: ...Did the trap get him? Or was he already down?
...Laying right beside the jaws. Don't look at the teeth.
...Iron teeth right by his side. Step around. Gently.
...He didn't see the plate. Just breathe... step around.
...Don't look down at him. Just look where you're putting your boots.
...One trip and that's it. Keep it together.
...Ugh... the smell. And a trap right beside him. God damn it.
...Poor guy. Stepped right into it, didn't you...?
psychology_near_corpse_aggressive: ...Get up. Come on, get up... damn it.
...Better not be whatever did this waiting around the corner.
psychology_near_corpse_stoic: ...Don't think about it. Just keep walking.
psychology_near_corpse_empathetic: ...Oh god... please don't let them have suffered.
...I can't... I can't look at their face.
...Poor guy. What a horrible way to go.
psychology_flashback_coping: Look at the floor. Just stone. Just gray stone.
Touch your face. You're alive. You're here.
It's not real. It's not real.
Breathe through your teeth... calm down...
Focus on your hands. Just hands.
psychology_flashback_fleeting: Just in my head. Keep moving.
Get a grip. It was nothing.
psychology_flashback_prolonged: Where am I?! It's happening again!
No, no, no... get out of my head!
Make it stop! Just make it stop!
I'm still there... I never left...
Wake up... damn it, wake up!
psychology_crisis_lashing: Stop looking at me like that!
I can't take this shit anymore!
Why does everything have to go to hell?!
psychology_combo_melancholy_frustration: Just break then. See if I care.
Fuck this. Fuck all of this.
Another failure. Add it to the pile.
psychology_combo_depressive_success: Doesn't make me feel any better.
psychology_combo_euphoria_frustration: NO! Not now! I'm RIGHT HERE!
Ha! You think that stops me?!
I've got this! Don't you dare ruin this!
psychology_combo_fear_anger: I'll take you down with me!
psychology_combo_panic_melancholy: I can't... we're never getting out...
No point... but I'm so scared...
I don't want to die like this...
psychology_combo_comfort_fear: It's a trap. It's gotta be.
Enjoy it while it lasts... won't be long.
psychology_dissociation_numb: Not mine. None of this is mine.
psychology_dissociation_breakdown: Oh God... oh God, I almost died back there.
My hands... they won't stop shaking...
What am I doing down here?! What is this place?!
I can't... I can't do this again...
It hurts... it all hurts so much now...
I was almost dead meat on the floor...
psychology_trio_doom: Nothing works, I'm freezing, and they're hunting us.
What a fucking joke this life is.
Why run anymore? There's nowhere to go.
I'm done for. Absolutely done for.
psychology_trio_berserk: AHAHAHA! CAN'T BREATHE AND DON'T CARE! COME ON!
KILL ME THEN! SEE WHAT HAPPENS!
HEART'S GOING TO EXPLODE! LETS GOOO!
I'M STILL HERE, YOU FUCKING MONSTERS!
psychology_trio_spiteful_respite: Sitting in the dirt feeling cozy. Pathetic.
A warm second before the slaughter. Fantastic.
I hate that this feels good. It changes nothing.
A pleasant moment in hell. Big whoop.
psychology_trio_feral_cornered: STOP FAILING! STOP CLICKING! SHUT UP!
I'LL BASH YOUR SKULL IN IF YOU COME CLOSER!
EVERYTHING IS GOING WRONG AT ONCE!
psychology_grounding_plushie: Just... hold onto it. It's soft.
Focus on the fluff. I'm okay. I'm here.
It's fine... it's just a toy, but... it helps.
psychology_grounding_meds: ...The pills are kicking in. Heart's slowing down.
Just let the fog roll in.
psychology_memory_meal: I remember having that food... that was really nice.
...At least I had something decent to eat back there.
Remember that meal? Felt human for a minute.
Good food. Wish I had more of it.
psychology_memory_injury_minor: Feet still throb a bit from landing rough.
...Bruised up, but it could've been a lot worse.
Just a scrape. Still aches though.
psychology_memory_injury: I still ache where I got mangled.
Can't shake the memory of getting torn open...
...That pain... almost didn't make it out.
Still stings when I move wrong.
psychology_memory_escape: Managed to dodge that trap... still got some reflexes left.
Got away by the skin of my teeth back there.
...Could've been shreds. Glad I reacted in time.
psychology_memory_horror_single: Why did they have to die like that?
That first body, it still sticks with me.
It was so much worse than when they just disappeared in the lab.
psychology_memory_horror_multiple: Am I just waiting for my turn to join the dead?
I think the word we learned for this kind of place is genocide...
psychology_memory_horror: Why did they have to die like that?
psychology_unchipped_somatic_anxiety: Too fast... can't catch my breath.
...Chest is tight. Need to calm down.
psychology_somatic_hypothermia: I'd l-love a human's c-c-coat right now... they looked warm.
psychology_somatic_hypovolemia: ...Need to stop the bleeding... getting so weak.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_low_vale: ...Body feels like lead. Can barely keep moving.
...Why am I even trying? Everything feels cold.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_high_aro: Chest feels tight... heart won't stop pounding against my ribs.
Hands won't stop shaking... need to breathe.
Everything's moving too fast. Can't steady myself.
psychology_unchipped_inspection_low_agen: ...Out of my hands. Completely out of my hands.
What was I even supposed to do coming here?
Can the scientists hear me? I need some instructions...!
psychology_unchipped_inspection_calm: ...Breathing is steady. One step at a time.
psychology_memory_trade: Good to speak with someone who didn't try to kill me.
...At least someone else is alive down here.
Felt nice doing a bit of business.
psychology_memory_craft_good: Put that together properly. Still useful.
Made something that works. That's something.
psychology_memory_craft_bad: What a mess that craft was...
psychology_memory_lab_calm: Faint memory of the holding cell... humming softly.
The light through the slit before the guards came by.
I remember the count-off before lockup. Just a number.
The room smelled like cold concrete. Still and quiet.
The laboratory was a strange place, they did so many tests.
I wonder how many of us were in the kennels, it was always changing.
Some of the humans were okay, I guess.
psychology_memory_lab_unsettling: Still remember the cold floor in that holding cell...
They dragged me out before I could even stand on my own.
The blinding flash of the neural scan... still burns behind my eyes.
Someone was shouting through the cell door before they locked it.
Cold metal bench. Restraints clicking shut. I can't shake that feeling.
I hated how often the other sawians just vanished.
So many of the humans were just mean to us...
psychology_memory_general_positive: Things could be worse. I've had worse days.
Still breathing. That counts for something.
It's just another test to pass.
psychology_memory_general_negative: Everything just falls apart down here.
Just one bad thing after another.
psychology_dissociative_stare: ...Does any of this matter to you?
...Is someone on the other side of this?
psychology_futile_refusal: Why bother? It won't save us.
I can't. I just can't do it.
When can I build something that lets me leave?
psychology_medical_resigned_profound: Get fixed so I can get hurt again, and again
Everything just hurts down here anyway...
psychology_solitary_mutter: ...Check the pack, check the footing. One step at a time.
psychology_solitary_schizoid: ...Did you hear that? Shh. Don't answer.
...They know I'm here. The walls are listening.
psychology_trap_calm_recognition: ...I know that spinup sound. Stay low.
...Heard that charge before. Keep clear of the line of fire.
...Beep again. Not catching me this time.
psychology_flashlight_died_joyous: Great. Just great. Come on, don't do this to me now...
Okay, not funny. Anyone got a spare cell?!
Ah, wonderful. Flying blind in a cave. What could go wrong?
Work, you little bulb! I was actually in a good mood!
...And the light dies. Because of course it does.
psychology_flashlight_died_angry: Are you kidding me?! Piece of junk! Work, damn it!
Die now?! Of all the goddamn times!
Tch! Useless piece of scrap! *shakes flashlight furiously*
Fucking dead battery! You've got to be shitting me!
Work! *bangs against palm* Don't make me smash you into the wall!
psychology_flashlight_died_sorrow: Of course. Leave me in the dark too. Why wouldn't you...
I knew it would fail. Everything down here fails.
...Can't even have a little light. Just swallow me whole, then.
Darkness. Back where I belong, I guess.
psychology_flashlight_died_neutral: Tch. Dead battery. Pitch black. Have to move by feel.
Battery depleted. Keep your hands on the wall.
psychology_darkness_wandering: Did something just move out there? Keep moving...
Eyes straining... can't see five feet ahead.
Every shadow feels like it's creeping closer...
Need a flare or a campfire... anything with a flame.
Just keep one hand on the rock. Don't lose your balance.
Sounded like breathing... No, just the wind through the cracks.
psychology_trap_sonar_angry: Is that all you've got?! Ears are ringing, piece of scrap!
Agh! Rattled my teeth, you bastard!
Cheap sonic wave! Try harder next time!
Ear-piercing piece of shit! I'll dismantle you!
psychology_trap_sonar_joyous_hit: Guh! My head... that vibrated my entire skull! Not good!
Whoa! Felt that in my teeth! That was way too close!
Ow, ow, ow! Okay, brain definitely rattled on that one!
Agh! My ears! Still standing, though!
psychology_trap_sonar_sorrow_hit: Can't even think... just endless ringing...
Head splitting open... why bother dodging...
Everything vibrates... can't even hear my own breathing...
Just let the wave crush my skull next time.
psychology_trap_sonar_neutral_miss: Sonic wave missed. Ear protection held. Keep moving.
Sonar blast off-target. Moving to flank.
psychology_trap_turret_joyous_hit: Agh! Damn it—I was feeling good for once! That stung!
Ow! Okay, lesson learned, don't celebrate early!
Grazed me! Son of a bitch had lead with my name on it!
psychology_trap_turret_angry_hit: You mechanical bastard! I'll tear you apart!
Keep shooting, machine! See who dies first!
Rrrgh! Hit me, did you?! You're dead scrap metal!
psychology_trap_turret_sorrow_hit: Bleeding again... of course it had a clean angle on me.
Just put another hole in me, why don't you...
More lead in my meat. What else is new.
psychology_trap_beartrap_sorrow_hit: Of course. A bear trap. Why wouldn't it be my <limb>...
Chewed right through my <limb>... just leave me here.
Clamped down to the marrow. Figures.
psychology_trap_beartrap_angry_hit: Rrrgh! Filthy rusted teeth! Get off my <limb>!
Damn jaw snapped right into the bone! Rrrgh!
Fucking spring trap! Prying you open with my bare hands!
psychology_trap_beartrap_joyous_freed: Ha! Teeth didn't take the whole <limb>! We're still walking!
Out of the jaws! Still got both feet!
Pried loose! Flesh tore, but I'm still mobile!
psychology_trap_mine_tactical: Blast wave! Clear the corridor! Check for shrapnel!
Concussion wave passed! Eyes sharp, check your gear!
psychology_trap_mine_angry_miss: Missed me, you piece of rust! Nice try!
Triggered too early, you piece of junk! Ha!
Just gravel and smoke! Not good enough!
psychology_mp_peer_trap_worry: Comrade hit! Watch the perimeter, get them clear!
Hang on! I see the trap, don't move!
Watch your footing! Trap in the sector!
psychology_mp_peer_trap_grief: NO! God, they got shredded... Why didn't I see it?!
They're gone... torn apart in a second...
Not like this... God, not like this...
Nothing left of them... Damn this cave!
psychology_mp_peer_saved: Thank god... you made it through that.
Hang in there. We're still breathing.
You're patched up. Stay close, we move together.
Got you back on your feet. Keep your eyes open.
psychology_lab_sensory_detached: ...Smells like the damp air from the holding blocks.
...Heard that hum through the heavy cell door once.
...Sterile hiss. Reminds me of the pre-transfer prep.
Cold air. Like stepping onto the cell block floor.
...Smells like the disinfectant wash back then.
psychology_lab_sensory_dread: ...That smell. That's the sterilant from the detention wing.
...I know that frequency. The guards used that before the sweep.
Whatever happens. Don't lock me back in that cell. Please.
...Restraints clicking. Can still feel the straps.
I hope that stuff they poked me with is all worked out by now.
psychology_recovery_minor: I'll be good as new soon.
psychology_recovery_major: As long as I don't get another of those.
I can barely believe I survived that.
psychology_suicide_defiant_rage: [PLACEHOLDER: Defiant rage gun suicide abortion scream]
psychology_suicide_aborted: What am I doing, what am I doing...?
psychology_item_lost_joyous: Maybe I'll find something better below.
Maybe I'll find it down a bit further?
psychology_item_lost_melancholic: Of fucking course. Another thing lost.
Why do I even bother carrying anything?
I probably needed that one too.
Just when it couldn't have gotten worse.
psychology_item_lost_paranoid: Where is it?! I had it right here!
No, no, no...! Who kicked it away?!
The humans made me drop it, I just know it
It had to have pulled itself away, they're testing me!
psychology_craft_apathetic: Built. Still trapped in this hole.
Back to building like a drone.
psychology_craft_frustrated: Why can't anything just be easy to get?
It might be fun to make all this if my LIFE didn't depend on it!
psychology_craft_triumphant: Solid. One less thing to worry about.
Hey hey, I can make anything!
One step closer to surviving this cave.
psychology_craft_manic: I can't wait to make another!
Ooh, I'll be out of here in no time.
psychology_injury_defiant: Bandage it later. Not done yet.
It'll take more than that to stop me.
I'll be fine, it's no worse than the training.
psychology_injury_resigned: I guess I should bandage it up.
It's not like I can stop getting hurt.
This is just going to keep happening, isn't it?
psychology_injury_terrified: Please, someone, I need help, fast.!
I need to do something before it gets worse!
psychology_medical_pragmatic: Set straight. It'll fix up okay.
psychology_weapon_jam_panic: Clear it, clear it, come on!
Guns aren't supposed to do that!
psychology_weapon_jam_rage: Clear it, you piece of shit!
psychology_isolation_exhausted: ...How long have I been down here...?
psychology_craft_mutilation_panic: [PLACEHOLDER: Panicked reaction to catastrophic crafting mutilation]
psychology_craft_mutilation_defiant: ...Gah! Caught the flesh... grr. Just blood.
...Ripped skin. Bandage it later, keep working.
...Tch. Slipped into the mechanism. I'm fine.
psychology_craft_mutilation_resigned: ...Can't even put two parts together without bleeding.
psychology_craft_ruined_joyous: ...Well, that's completely mangled! Worth a shot.
...Total failure. At least it didn't blow up.
psychology_craft_ruined_rage: ...Fucking piece of rusted scrap! Damned garbage!
...Snapping in two?! Are you fucking kidding me?!
...Useless trash! Every single part is rotten!
psychology_craft_ruined_melancholy: ...Can't even build right anymore. What's the point?
psychology_craft_botched_resigned: ...Botched the finish. It'll have to do.
psychology_craft_first_failure: ...Failed on the very first try. Unbelievable.
...Can't even put two pieces of scrap together.
...First thing I touch and it's already trash.
psychology_brain_disorientation: ...Where... which way did I come from?
psychology_dossier_reaction: At least they got my height right.
Paper... might be able to rip this for bandages.
Could use this as kindling if it gets freezing.
They couldn't even leave me a pen.
Guess I'm stuck carrying this clipboard.
psychology_weapon_jam_sorrow: ...Of course it jams. Just end it.
...Just give up. Even the rifle wants me dead.
psychology_weapon_empty_panic: ...Nothing left?! Where did it all go?!
psychology_weapon_safety_calm: ...Safety engaged. Need to flick it off.
psychology_vomit_sickness: ...Can't keep it down. The fever's getting worse.
psychology_vomit_disgust: ...Can't scrub the taste out of my mouth.
psychology_sleep_paralysis: ...Couldn't move... couldn't scream... something was in the corner.
...Pinned down... chest felt like lead... please don't let me sleep again.
...Eyes open, but the body was dead... god, it was right there.
psychology_nightmare_woke_shook: ...Huff... just a dream. Just a dream. Still breathing.
psychology_craft_failure: Well... guess I have to start over.
psychology_paralysis: ...Shadow in the corner... move, damn it...
mindclean_relief: The screaming in my ears, fucking finally...
Ughhh... I can think clearly again.
Clean slate. Or clean enough to keep walking.
Why were my hands shaking so badly?... Oh well.
mindclean_sideeffect: Wait... what was I trying to remember? Something good just slipped away.
I can't picture my friend's face anymore. Just static.
Forgot what... uhhh... I don't even know.
treatment_major_stabilized: Holding pressure... God, that was close.
Bandage is soaking through, but it stopped the worst of it.
treatment_minor_scrape: Cleaned it up. Back to moving.
psychology_condition_depression: ...Can't feel the ground under my boots.
psychology_condition_learned_helplessnes: ...Every door leads to the same dirt.
psychology_condition_grounded: Deep breath. Feet on the ground.

moodle.panickingdsc: Autonomic shock response. Ragged respiration, motor tremor, and severe peripheral tunnel vision.
moodle.panicking1dsc: Shallow respiration, cold sweat, and persistent nervous tremor.
moodle.panicking2dsc: Autonomic shock response. Ragged respiration, motor tremor, and narrowing peripheral vision.
moodle.panicking3dsc: Violent hyperventilation, debilitating tremor, and severe autonomic shock.
moodle.panicking4dsc: Complete psychological collapse. Inability to maintain coherent thought or behavior.
moodle.panicking_veterandsc: Familiar battle surge. Nerves humming raw, but training fights the tremor.
moodle.flashbackdsc: Sensory echo and visceral dread triggered by conditioned environmental trauma.
moodle.flashback1dsc: Residual auditory glitches and phantom clicks slowly fading back into ambient silence.
moodle.flashback2dsc: Distant sensory echoes and visceral dread triggered by conditioned environmental trauma.
moodle.flashback3dsc: Overwhelming auditory glitches and visceral flashback flooding the senses.
moodle.flashback4dsc: Intense, detailed flashbacks that feel as real as the original traumatic event.
moodle.flashback_veterandsc: Old memories crawling back. Recognizing the phantom noise for what it is.
moodle.frustrateddsc: Compounding friction and thwarted agency. Motor control is twitchy and irritable.
moodle.frustrated1dsc: Compounding friction and thwarted agency. Motor control is twitchy and irritable.
moodle.frustrated2dsc: Escalating volatile tension. Jittery limbs and sudden spikes of irritable anger.
moodle.frustrated3dsc: Overwhelming sense of helplessness. Motor control is erratic and unpredictable.
moodle.frustrated_veterandsc: Obstacles grinding against tired patience. Snapping through friction with brute resolve.
moodle.melancholicdsc: Severe depressive inertia. Physical agency has collapsed into heavy, numb resignation.
moodle.melancholic1dsc: A dull, creeping numbness. Physical agency is sluggish and heavy.
moodle.melancholic2dsc: Persistent depressive inertia. Tasks feel pointless, and the limbs feel like lead.
moodle.melancholic3dsc: Severe depressive inertia. Physical agency has collapsed into heavy, numb resignation.
moodle.melancholic4dsc: An overwhelming sense of hopelessness. Physical agency is completely absent or detrimented.
moodle.melancholic_veterandsc: The depths take everything, yet scarred limbs keep dragging forward out of stubborn spite.
moodle.resilientdsc: Steady nerves and grounded perceived agency. Motor control is clear and deliberate.
moodle.resilient1dsc: Steady nerves and grounded perceived agency. Motor control is clear and deliberate.
moodle.resilient2dsc: Unyielding resolve and razor focus. Perceived agency remains unshakable despite the depths.
moodle.resilient3dsc: An unwavering determination that persists despite overwhelming adversity.
moodle.resilient_veterandsc: Tempered by trauma and survival. Steady hands, clear vision, and absolute clarity.

ui.psychology_cond_depression_desc: Persistent affective collapse and paralyzed agency. Normal activities fail to provide relief.
ui.psychology_cond_learned_helplessness_des: Deep cognitive conditioning that struggle is futile. Requires deliberate successes to break.
ui.psychology_cond_hypervigilance_desc: Continuous sympathetic overload and autonomic scan, draining nervous reserves.
ui.psychology_cond_agitation_desc: Restless, explosive irritable drive fueled by high stress and obstructed goals.
ui.psychology_cond_catatonia_desc: Severe vegetative freeze response; profound motor and vocal deceleration under overwhelming despair.
ui.psychology_cond_anhedonia_desc: Complete blunting of positive affect; unable to derive satisfaction or warmth.
ui.psychology_cond_paranoia_desc: Feverish distrust and persecutory dread; every shadow and companion feels threatening.
ui.psychology_cond_delirium_desc: Sensory dissociation and mental disorientation induced by agonizing pain and physical trauma.
ui.psychology_cond_sensory_overload_desc: Auditory and visual hypersensitivity; sudden noises trigger painful startle responses.
ui.psychology_cond_flow_desc: Deep task immersion and steady motor rhythm born from skilled execution.
ui.psychology_cond_grounded_desc: Somatic anchor and autonomic equilibrium achieved through comfort, warmth, and rest.
ui.psychology_cond_catharsis_desc: Sudden visceral release of pent-up terror following survival or overcoming death.
ui.psychology_cond_euphoria_desc: Intense neuro-chemical surge blunting pain and elevating confidence to reckless heights.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_mindwipe: The mind has been severed from its past. There is no joy, no terror, and no memory—only a hollow silence.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_valence_neg: • Weighted by persistent sorrow and gloom.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_valence_severe_pos: • Uplifted by a rare surge of euphoria.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_valence_pos: • Holding onto a faint glimmer of optimism.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_valence_neutral: • Numb, feeling neither joy nor deep despair.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_arousal_severe_high: • Heart pounding violently; nerves frayed raw.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_arousal_high: • High-strung and on edge, scanning every shadow.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_arousal_low: • Lethargic and hollow; reaction times dragging.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_high: • Determined to survive, feeling capable and driven.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_steady: • Maintaining steady focus and control over immediate tasks.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_low: • Clinging to whatever small control remains.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_agency_severe_low: • Helpless against the depths, feeling like prey.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_pred_disoriented: • Disoriented by the treacherous, unfamiliar cavern.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_panic_siege: • Under acute somatic panic siege: hyperventilating, hands shaking.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_corpse_calloused: • Calloused to death; the sight of corpses no longer registers.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_corpse_repulsed: • Repulsed by the stench and presence of the dead.
ui.psychology_wv_desc_trap_crawling: • Skin crawling from the proximity of hair-trigger traps.
ui.psychology_dossier_item_desc: Preliminary neuro-psychiatric assessment document and telemetry baseline. Drag to center to examine.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_basal: Baseline autonomic and somatic stability within standard calibration parameters.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_masochist: Inverted nociceptive response; paradoxically stabilized by somatic injury.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_stoic_vanguard: High somatic pain tolerance coupled with rapid cognitive stress recovery.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_acute_reactive: Heightened autonomic arousal and acute pain sensitivity under physical threat.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_combative: Elevated defensive arousal; converts perceived vulnerability into combative action.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_passive: Marked passivity in conflict scenarios; low autonomic threat response.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_blunted_pain: Blunted pain conduction; heightened physical endurance during trauma.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_acute_pain: Sensory-sensitive pain conduction; requires careful somatic management.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_resilient: Rapid cognitive recalibration and sustained agency retention following crises.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_fragile: Vulnerable stress threshold; susceptible to cognitive degradation during sustained peril.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_high_strung: Elevated startle reflex and sympathetic arousal reactivity.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_cold_blooded: Attenuated autonomic response; maintains steady heart rate under acute stress.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_balanced: Balanced psychological baseline across standard behavioral and autonomic vectors.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_neurotic: Severe autonomic volatility; heightened sympathetic hyperventilation and panic cascading under stress.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_optimist: Persistent affective resilience; maintains positive valence baseline and resists existential demoralization.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_pessimist: Anticipatory disaster bias; suppressed baseline mood but heightened cognitive stability when catastrophes occur.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_fatalist: Resigned fatalistic outlook; blunted panic response coupled with diminished individual agency.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_stoic_philo: Suppressed sympathetic reactivity; sustains low baseline arousal and resists affective panic.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_nihilist: Existential detachment; immune to corpse horror and clone copy crises, with blunted intrinsic motivation.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_cynic: Defensive interpersonal cynicism; impervious to trader deception shock and social betrayal.
ui.psychology_dossier_assess_attachment: Socially dependent; relies heavily on companionship and suffers acute loneliness when isolated.
ui.mindcleandsc: A 60ml pill bottle. Prepared with 45ml of mindclean and 15ml of opium to ease acute trauma and soothe distress.
ui.mindclean_liquiddsc: Specially synthesized palliative neuro-scrub engineered as a softer alternative to a total mindwipe. Selectively scrubs acute traumatic memory engrams and dampens hyper-aroused affective distress while preserving identity, motor faculties, and baseline survival conditioning.
